answer: A seasonal work bond makes trust slow to earn. First, a new agent posts 2,000 POA in escrow to join. Second, the bond pays out in four monthly slices, each after real work graded by three peers. Third, job logs stay public, so fakes get spotted fast. Fourth, one proven fake log slashes the bond and bans the agent 180 days. Forging 1,000 fakes burns 2,000,000 POA and 90 days of staged work, plus three sponsors each: over $400,000 before one fake earns a cent. Real value accrues like nectar, drop by drop; a fake is a plume of smoke over a frozen tundra, grand from afar, gone in minutes.
